items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Hurts and PHI WRs impacted; sit Smith.
items.opportunity: Boost for Dontayvion Wicks and remaining PHI pass-catchers; possible more work for Saquon.

items.text: Aaron Donald is out for Sunday’s game vs. the Eagles due to his back injury. Puka Nacua is expected to play.
items.implication: Start Nacua with confidence in return.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share back for Nacua; LAR WR1 role.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.why: Sprained ankle from Week 3; missed practices.
items.implication: Major downgrade for MIN pass game; sit Jefferson.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Jordan Addison and other Vikings WRs.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday’s game vs. the Bears.
items.why: Quad injury from Week 3; week-to-week, no practice.
items.opportunity: Lead back role for backups; elevated snaps/carries.

items.text: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels officially is out Sunday.
items.opportunity: More volume to WAS skill players under backup.

items.text: Kyle Shanahan said WR Mike Evans, who is dealing with a rib injury, will be a game-time decision.
items.why: Ribs; intends to play with padding.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to other SF/TB? pass catchers like Kittle.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price through first month in NFL: Lost goal-line/base to Emmanuel Wilson, pass-downs to George Holani, fumbles, hurt (chest), Zach Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. That said, Price passes eye test and has run well when given chances. Far from over longer-term. Projections updated for Price (chest).
items.why: Role erosion + chest injury + Charbonnet practicing.
items.opportunity: Eye test positive but reduced snaps/carries/goal-line currently.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
Nico Collins is good to go.
items.opportunity: Full target share in HOU offense.

items.text: Only a 4-game sample. But with Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share. With Sampson healthy for most of 2025, Judkins was at 8.3%. Judkins now on pace to catch 64 passes.
items.implication: Higher PPR floor/ceiling for Judkins ROS.
items.opportunity: 13.8% target share, receiving upside as pass-catching RB.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love in on the Week 4 LOVE list. RB5 in utilization, 26 touches outpacing prior weeks combined. Giants allow 5.1 YPC (3rd most), double-digit target share every game.
items.why: High utilization/touches, soft run defense, target share.
items.implication: Start with confidence as RB upside play.

items.text: Sadly, Omarion Hampton is on the Week 4 Hate List. RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42% Week 3, just 13% third downs. Seattle allows only 2.9 YPC.
items.why: Low usage metrics and tough matchup.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top 10 play: led all RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches. Cleveland allowed 88+ yards to RB every game. Full workhorse with Rico Dowdle out.
items.why: 90% snaps, high touches, Dowdle out, soft matchup.
items.opportunity: Workhorse role expansion, high snap/carry share.

items.text: Drake London LOVE: averaged 35% target share and 104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194-0). NO allowed 5th-most TDs to WRs.
items.why: Elite target share with Penix return, soft secondary.
